summary.text: Fairy Yao Guang is a female Gu Immortal who sells starlight fireflies and detailed star fragment grass farming knowledge through treasure yellow heaven.

claims.text: Fang Yuan first meets the name when he pushes remnant Immortal Gu recipes into treasure yellow heaven to buy starlight fireflies and a female Gu Immortal answers that she nurtures a large number of them in her blessed land and wishes to exchange. She is one of three competing sellers with Starlord Wan Xiang and Di Yuan; her offered swarm shows the feeblest treasure light of the three, only three meters, while the others show five and a half and seven meters.

Fang Yuan next buys seeds and farming knowledge from the same three sellers. Her document shows the greatest treasure light of the set, nearly two meters tall. By divine sense she says she is most fond of growing grass and deliberately migrated a small swarm of starlight fireflies for star fragment grass production, claiming that following her instructions will avoid losses. Among the three writeups, hers is the verbose and detailed one, and Fang Yuan uses all three to memorize star fragment grass cultivation.

During the earlier transaction she suggested buying cloud soil to raise star fragment grass, but Fang Yuan skipped that buy because Hu Immortal blessed land already held vast dark clouds he could plant on instead.

Later inspection of those plantings credits her methods: star fragment grass feeds starlight fireflies, and the fireflies in turn speed the grass’s growth. Fang Yuan names the breeding insights bought from Star Lord Wan Xiang, Fairy Yao Guang, and others as what let him avoid many detours.
When haggling over starlight firefly Gu price, Fang Yuan names her and Di Yuan as other sellers he can turn to besides the merchant in front of him.
